answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pigment of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
